verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows attach to scheduling links and fire meeting-lifecycle messages and actions at customizable times, such as reminders before a meeting. That is time-based automation, but it is tied to bookings rather than to independent recurring schedules. Zapier can extend these event-triggered automations, but nothing shows SavvyCal itself running recurring jobs. missing for 10: standalone recurring/cron-style job scheduling, API or agent-driven creation of scheduled workflows, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
